newsitem.title: CANADA: Mitel shares jump after upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Mitel shares jump after upgrade.

text.p: Shares in Mitel Corp jumped on Wednesday after an analyst upgraded his rating and price target for the stock.
Alain Boileau of Newcrest Capital Inc raised Mitel to a buy from a market perform and bumped his 12-month target to C$14 from C$11, Newcrest said.
Newcrest said Boileau expects Mitel to earn C$0.53 in the year ending March 1997 and C$0.70 in fiscal 1998.
The analyst was not immediately available for comment.
"Boileau's 100 percent of what's going on. There's nothing else," said one portfolio manager.
The portfolio manager said Boileau's upgrade was partly due to the prospect of increased revenues for Mitel's semiconductor business.
Mitel shares were up 0.85 at 10.05 in brisk turnover of 2.05 million shares. They hit a 52-week high of 10.15 earlier.
